name: The Apple Orchard Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Lachen is restricted-zone entry — almost all dining is within hotels. Apple Orchard's multi-cuisine restaurant is the most-cited, with a fireplace dining hall and a packed-breakfast service for the 4.30am Gurudongmar Lake start.
insider_tip: Non-residents are rare — book stay+meals together. Ask reception the night before for the packed breakfast; they'll send you off at 4.30am with hot tea and parathas in a tiffin.
signature_address: The Apple Orchard Resort, Lachen 737120, North Sikkim
